unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 9 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.1 - THEME 5: LIFE IN THE NEIGHBOURHOOD, CITY & SOCIAL LIFE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will produce a project including the sub-themes ''Life in the Neighbourhood, City, and Social Life'' by focussing on city development and infrastructure, urban and rural lifestyles, and the future of cities. Students will research and compare urban and rural living. They will focus on daily life, opportunities, and challenges in each item. They will create a presentation with a poster showing how infrastructure such as transportation, housing, and public spaces influences city life. Additionally, students will imagine and design a ''City of the Future,'' displaying innovative solutions for sustainable living, improved infrastructure, and community well-being. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the neighbourhood, city and social life with its components such as city development and infrastructure; urban and rural lifestyles; future of cities'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school may know what city development and infrastructure; urban and rural lifestyles; future of cities mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the neighbourhood, city and social life'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the neighbourhood, city and social life with its components such as city development and infrastructure; urban and rural lifestyles; future of cities'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss about the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To express opinions about ''ideal city'' or ''rural setting'' in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: My Ideal City Students write a paragraph describing their ideal city or rural place by using target vocabulary such as adjectives and adverbs (e.g. advanced, innovative, eco-friendly, vibrant). Example: ''My ideal city will be eco-friendly and sustainable with vibrant streets and eco-friendly living spaces. Public transportation will operate efficiently and automatically and it is connecting every corner of the city. Rural areas are peaceful and tranquil. They offer a simple but authentic lifestyle far from the fast-paced life of urban centres''. The teachers gives feedback on students’ papers on creativity and effective use of language. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To describe ''city development and infrastructure; urban and rural lifestyles; future of cities'' with causes and effects in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Urban life and rural life In this activity, the teacher gives students two parts of a sentence, and they must match them by using a connecting word (e.g. because, but, so, while). For example: Part 1: The city is crowded. Part 2: Rural areas are quiet. The combined sentence might be: The city is crowded but rural areas are quiet. Another example: Part 1: The council is building new roads. Part 2: People will travel faster. The combined sentence might be: The council is building new roads so people will travel faster. To support learners, s/he provides a list of connecting words with definitions and examples to make the activity easier for them. The teacher gives feedback on accuracy and use of the target language including the target vocabulary and pronunciation. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
